newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-FORMER OLYMPIC CHAMPION TULU FAILS TO MAKE FINAL.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-FORMER OLYMPIC CHAMPION TULU FAILS TO MAKE FINAL.

text.p: Ethiopia's former Olympic champion Derartu Tulu failed to qualify for the women's world 10,000 metres final on Saturday after struggling home in 11th place in the first round heats.

Tulu, who was fourth at last year's Atlanta Olympics and second at the last world championships in 1995, could not keep up with the leading pack in the later stages of her heat on the hard Athens track which is fine for sprinters but tough for distance runners.
Portugal's Olympic and reigning world champion Fernanda Ribeiro easily qualified, finishing second in the other heat in 32:05.65.
